sloka: अपरे वीरण स्तम्बान् बलिनो बलवत्तराः ।विधमन्ति स्म दुर्गाणि स्थलानि च ततः ततः ॥२-८०-८॥
transliteration: apare vīraṇa stambān balino balavattarāḥ ।vidhamanti sma durgāṇi sthalāni ca tataḥ tataḥ ॥2-80-8॥

translations.english: Some other stronger men, plucked the strongrooted tufts of fragrant grass. Here and there they made impassable terrains even.
